data.long_meaning: Bratindra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brahma' meaning God or Supreme Being and 'Indra' meaning Lord of the Universe. This name signifies the divine power and supremacy of the deity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra is known as the king of the gods and the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Naming a child Bratindra is believed to bestow upon them divine blessings and protection.
